summary: Genuinely mutual NDA on Vantage's paper with a standard confidentiality core, but it adds a residuals clause, a 12-month non-compete/exclusivity restriction, narrow Representatives and Luxembourg law with exclusive Luxembourg courts.

findings.quote: which is marked confidential or should reasonably be understood to be confidential given its nature and context of disclosure
findings.why: Definition covers Purpose-related information that is marked or reasonably confidential, and applies to either Party as Disclosing Party.

findings.quote: Disclosing Party means a Party disclosing Confidential Information.
findings.why: Disclosing and Receiving Party are defined so either Party can be either, and the obligations bind both equally.

findings.quote: use the Confidential Information solely for evaluating and pursuing the Permitted Purpose
findings.why: Use is limited solely to the Permitted Purpose, being discussions on a prospective commercial partnership.

findings.quote: Representative means, in relation to a Party, its directors, officers, employees, professional advisers, and approved financing sources.
findings.why: Representatives do not include auditors, insurers or Group members/Affiliates, and there is no consent mechanism for Group disclosure.
findings.draft_redline: Representative means, in relation to a Party, its and its Group members' directors, officers, employees, professional advisers, auditors and insurers, in each case on a need-to-know basis.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We need to be able to share information on a need-to-know basis with our auditors, insurers and group companies, for whom we remain responsible. We have extended the definition accordingly.

findings.quote: is or becomes publicly available without breach of this Agreement;
findings.why: All four carve-outs are present (public domain, already held, lawfully received from a third party, independently developed) without narrowing.

findings.quote: Nothing in this Agreement shall restrict either Party or its Affiliates from using, disclosing, or commercialising any ideas, concepts, know-how, techniques, or information retained in the unaided memory of its personnel
findings.why: This is a residuals clause permitting use and commercialisation of information retained in unaided memory.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 3.2 and the words 'and Residuals' from the heading of Clause 3.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are unable to agree a residuals clause as it would undermine the protection of each Party's confidential information. We have deleted it.

findings.quote: to the minimum extent required by mandatory statutory provision, court order, or binding rule of a competent regulatory or supervisory authority, provided that, to the extent legally permissible, the Receiving Party gives prompt written notice
findings.why: Compelled disclosure is permitted for law, court and regulator with notice only where legally permissible and no obligation to resist at the Receiving Party's cost; stock exchange rules are not mentioned.

findings.quote: neither Party shall, directly or indirectly, whether as principal, agent, partner, or through any Affiliate, engage in the development, marketing, licensing, or commercial distribution of any cloud-based workflow automation or middleware software that competes directly with the core software product lines disclosed by the other Party
findings.why: A non-compete for the term plus 12 months, together with a bar on integration or co-marketing with named competitors, restricts each Party's business.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are not able to accept restrictions on either Party's business activities in a confidentiality agreement. We have deleted Clause 5; the confidentiality obligations already protect the information each Party shares.

findings.quote: the Receiving Party shall promptly destroy or return all tangible and electronic embodiments of Confidential Information, retaining only one copy strictly for legal compliance or dispute defence
findings.why: Return is 'promptly' rather than within a stated period, there is no signed confirmation, and a retained copy for dispute defence and backup records are not stated to remain confidential.
findings.draft_redline: Within 10 Business Days of written request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy the Confidential Information and confirm this in writing, save that it may retain copies held in automated backups or required to be kept by law or regulation, which shall remain subject to this Agreement.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We have set a clear 10 Business Day period for return or destruction and confirmed that backup and legally required copies may be kept, remaining confidential.

findings.quote: This Agreement takes effect on the date first written above and expires after two (2) years.
findings.why: Two-year term and three-year survival match the preferred position; Trade Secret protection is not addressed but no deviation arises.

findings.quote: the non-defaulting Party shall be entitled, immediately and as a matter of right, to seek and obtain emergency injunctive relief, specific performance, and any other provisional remedies
findings.why: The equitable relief is strongly worded but mutual, with no bond required and remedies cumulative.
findings.fallback_cited: Strongly worded but mutual equitable relief.

findings.quote: No licence, title, or interest under any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret, or other intellectual property right is granted or implied by this Agreement.
findings.why: No licence or IP interest is granted and there is no assignment or feedback licence.
findings.fallback_cited: Statement that each party owns its own IP and no licence is granted (any wording).

findings.quote: shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. The courts of the district of Luxembourg City shall have exclusive jurisdiction
findings.why: Governing law is Luxembourg and jurisdiction is exclusive to Luxembourg courts, not England and Wales.
findings.draft_redline: This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales. The courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are unable to agree Luxembourg law and courts, and our standard is English law. If it assists, we could consider English law with non-exclusive jurisdiction.
